The winning team played the [[2003–04 Primera B Nacional#Promotion Playoff Primera División-Primera B Nacional|Promotion Playoff Primera División-Primera B Nacional]]. {{TwoLeg start}} |- !colspan="5"|Final {{TwoLegResult|'''[[Argentinos Juniors]]'''| |2–1|[[Godoy Cruz Antonio Tomba|Godoy Cruz]]| |0–1|2–0}} {{end}} ==Promotion playoff Primera División-Primera B Nacional== The Second Promotion playoff loser ([[Huracán de Tres Arroyos|Huracán (TA)]]) and the Torneo Reducido Winner ([[Argentinos Juniors]]) played against the 18th and the 17th placed of the Relegation Table of [[2003–04 Argentine Primera División|2003–04 Primera División]]. {{TwoLeg start}} |- !colspan="5"|Relegation/promotion playoff 1 {{TwoLegResult|'''[[Huracán de Tres Arroyos|Huracán (Tres Arroyos)]]'''||5–3|[[Atlético de Rafaela]]||2–1|3–2}} |- !colspan="5"|Relegation/promotion playoff 2 {{TwoLegResult|'''[[Argentinos Juniors]]'''||4–2 |[[Talleres de Córdoba|Talleres (C)]]||2–1|2–1}} |- |} * Huracán (TA) was promoted to [[2004–05 Argentine Primera División|2004–05 Primera División]] by winning the playoff and Atlético de Rafaela was relegated to the [[2004–05 Primera B Nacional]]. * Argentinos Juniors was promoted to [[2004–05 Argentine Primera División|2004–05 Primera División]] by winning the playoff and Talleres (C) was relegated to the [[2004–05 Primera B Nacional]]. ==Relegation== Note: Clubs with indirect affiliation with [[Asociación del Fútbol Argentino|AFA]] are relegated to the [[Torneo Argentino A]], while clubs directly affiliated face relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]].
